extracted.intended_audience: investors in Vanguard-advised funds; public companies and other stakeholders interested in Vanguard's investment stewardship activities
extracted.subtask_short: quarterly engagement reporting for investor stewardship
extracted.subtask_description: A Vanguard Investment Stewardship quarterly engagement report listing companies engaged during the quarter and describing the program's engagement topics, purpose, scope, and disclosure practices. It is intended to inform investors and companies about stewardship dialogues and how those dialogues relate to proxy voting and governance positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of engagement dialogues
rubrics_metrics.description: Candid and constructive discussions with directors and executives of companies held in Vanguard-advised funds are an important part of our Investment Stewardship program and help to inform our proxy voting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These dialogues enable us to deepen our understanding of, and share our perspectives on, a wide range of corporate governance topics associated with long-term shareholder returns. Each engagement is focused on better understanding a company’s corporate governance practices with respect to a particular topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board composition and effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Board composition and effectiveness is listed as a primary topic of engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bullets (•) indicate primary topics of the engagement. Engagements on this topic focus on understanding a company’s governance practices related to board structure, skills, diversity, independence, and how effectively the board oversees the company.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board oversight of strategy and risk
rubrics_metrics.description: Board oversight of strategy and risk is listed as a primary topic of engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagements on this topic focus on how the board oversees corporate strategy and material risks that could affect long-term shareholder returns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive pay
rubrics_metrics.description: Executive pay is listed as a primary topic of engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagements on this topic probe compensation practices and alignment of pay with long-term shareholder interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shareholder rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Shareholder rights is listed as a primary topic of engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagements on this topic cover protections and mechanisms that affect shareholders’ ability to hold management and boards accountable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement approach and limits (do not dictate or pursue policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: With respect to companies held by Vanguard-advised funds, we do not seek to dictate strategy or operations, nor do the Vanguard-advised funds submit shareholder proposals or nominate board members. Vanguard does not use investment stewardship activities to pursue any public policy objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We believe that the strategies and tactics for maximizing long-term shareholder returns should be decided by a company’s management and board of directors. Similarly, we believe that public policy, including public policy on social and environmental matters, is appropriately the responsibility of elected officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and disclosure commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to providing Vanguard-advised fund investors and other interested parties with information regarding the activities the Investment Stewardship team conducts on behalf of the funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vanguard publishes information regarding its voting and engagement activities, including the funds’ proxy voting policies, Insights, and quarterly reports, to promote good corporate governance practices and to provide public companies and investors with our perspectives on important governance topics and key votes. This is part of our effort to provide useful disclosure of Vanguard’s investment stewardship activities and to provide clarity on Vanguard’s positions beyond what a policy document or a single vote can provide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and applicability of stewardship activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Vanguard’s Investment Stewardship program is responsible for proxy voting and engagement on behalf of the quantitative and index equity portfolios advised by Vanguard (together, 'Vanguard-advised funds').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vanguard’s externally managed portfolios are managed by unaffiliated third‑party investment advisors, and proxy voting and engagement for those portfolios are conducted by their respective advisors. As such, throughout this document, 'we' refers to Vanguard’s Investment Stewardship program and 'the funds' refers to Vanguard-advised funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting format: company list and primary topics (quarterly)
rubrics_metrics.description: The report lists the companies that Vanguard’s Investment Stewardship team engaged with during the quarter and indicates primary topics of engagement with bullets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The following table lists the 356 companies that Vanguard’s Investment Stewardship team engaged with during the second quarter of 2025 (April–June 2025). Bullets (•) indicate primary topics of the engagement. However, because these are open dialogues that can cover a wide range of issues over multiple discussions, secondary topics often arise.
